item.title: FCC Chair: ‘I Was Highly Entertained’ by the ‘Hoax’ Colbert, Talarico Played on the Media
item.description: FCC Chair: ‘I Was Highly Entertained’ by the ‘Hoax’ Colbert, Talarico Played on the Media Federal Communications Commission (FCC) Chair Brendan Carr said at a press event Wednesday that he got a big laugh when he looked back at the way CBS “Late Show” Host Stephen Colbert used a hoax to manipulate the media this week.
